title: Can anyone identify this terrain shadow glitch? Appears momentarily and then is quickly gone again after a moment or two.
author: Recoil42

comments.author: ninjasaid13
comments.body: where did you find this glitch? unity?

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body: ThreeJS. Custom engine, I'm thinking it's z-fighting between two different terrain representations (one stale and yet evicted) but I was wondering if anyone recognized it as something else.

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body: Followup: It was indeed z-fighting between two different LODs, one stale and not being properly evicted.
